decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric was launched only in 2023 and has a page of its own, so its value is still uncertain, and keeping a fabric close to the established range in a broad collection costs little.
The bouclé-effect decorative fabric is only mentioned on the website, which suggests modest prominence, but one year is too short for its value to have resolved, and carrying it costs little.
The flame-retardant jacquard serves contract and hospitality demand, has a page of its own, and offers growth potential at low carrying cost, so the option is worth holding.

The double-face wool blend extends the range and fits the move toward renewable materials, but it is only mentioned on the website; its uncertainty has not resolved, so keeping the option is justified for now.

The wool bouclé leno fits the sustainability direction and has only been on the market since 2023, so its uncertain prospects favor keeping it despite its low visibility and the firm's many other products.
